rows.why: F14 · BACK TO CANVAS, the third of the three corrections, tried on ONE board first. Spec board 2844:12136 draws it as the topbar's LEFT control in full-page mode — rect 2844:12138 at board x+16, label 2844:12139 '‹ Back to canvas' — i.e. it REPLACES the exit control rather than sitting beside it, which is right: in full-page mode the action a person wants is returning to the canvas, not leaving for the dashboard. The text is WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT in a HORIZONTAL auto-layout topbar, so it should grow and push the title right; no `width` is passed, because forcing a width on a 32px box would wrap a topbar label onto several lines. Deliberately one board before five: if btn/exit turns out to be fixed-width the label escapes it, and a text row is fully reversible from the expect recorded here.
